original_test_intent: At a controlled 45C chamber condition, repeatedly retrain the selected GPU PCIe link across approved generations and intended lane widths for 1000 loops and prove every requested transition plus the final restored link completes without new errors.
original_method: Resolve authoritative loop contents and corrected AGT syntax/value mapping, pin endpoint/upstream topology and 45C sensor/tolerance/soak, preserve baseline link/AER/log state, execute one transition/readback at a time across the approved matrix with per-step and per-loop watchdogs, maintain independent chamber/power/GPU monitoring, stop on first anomaly, reconcile exactly 1000 complete loops and restore original link/chamber state.
manual_activity: PCIe/chamber owner resolves loop and width coverage, approves AGT mapping, 45C condition, 1000-cycle window and recovery, and owns verdict.
required_inputs: Signed AGT/hash and corrected vendor speed/width syntax
Stable endpoint/upstream BDF/GPU identity, capabilities and original link state
Decision on loop step range and width acceptance/support matrix
45C control sensor/location/tolerance/soak and safe chamber transition
Maintenance approval, telemetry, watchdog, abort/OOB and restore procedure
safety_requirements: Do not execute malformed or unresolved loop content
Verify stable endpoint/upstream after every retrain
Stop on chamber excursion, link loss, reset, AER/XID/log or power/thermal anomaly
Never clear baseline or continue to reach 1000 after first error
Restore original link and chamber condition and verify GPU/data-path health
agent_execution_scope: Await authoritative matrix and validate tool/topology/chamber gates
After approval execute one transition/readback at a time
Account for every complete loop and preserve error/thermal evidence
Stop-first-error, restore and report without DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve loop-step and width criteria conflict plus corrected syntax
Approve 45C definition, supported matrix and restore policy
Disposition incomplete/error transitions and set PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic speed loop does not cover the literal width operations, loop range conflict or per-step state.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Only after decision, use vendor-confirmed speed and width commands sequentially with status/AER/log readback; count a loop only when every approved transition finishes and preserve the first failure.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: 45C, 1,000 loops, Gen1..Gen4 and listed widths remain; ambiguous steps 20/21 and width acceptance remain pending, not silently dropped.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Emit a loop/transition ledger keyed by stable BDF containing requested/negotiated generation/width, AER/log delta, chamber temperature and completion, then reconcile 1,000 full loops and restore baseline.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes the ambiguous loop boundary explicit and creates lossless per-setting endurance evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Speed-only evidence cannot substitute for listed width operations unless engineering explicitly removes that coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Forcing unsupported lane widths may cause intentional downtraining or link loss; the support matrix determines expected behavior and cannot be inferred from capability alone.

project_override_considerations: PCIe owner defines supported transitions and chamber owner defines 45C at the relevant DUT sensor; environmental variants remain separate.
expected_evidence: Approved loop/matrix decision, AGT hash/syntax and stable endpoint/upstream topology
Every transition's requested/negotiated state, exact argv, status, duration and loop index
Complete/incomplete/failed loop reconciliation to 1,000 and first-failure record
Restored link/chamber/post-health evidence and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure lists width16/readback at steps20/21 but repeats only steps1..19, uses malformed width/path syntax, and Criteria accepts only speed; authoritative loop width coverage is indeterminate.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The conflict is preserved for engineering decision while static review and subsequent cases continue.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row239 Wistron-AMD GPU-00232-V002: decide whether each of 1,000 loops repeats literal steps1..19 (excluding width16/readback) or the full steps1..21; approve corrected AGT width syntax, speed mapping, supported/expected width PASS/FAIL rule missing from Criteria, and the 45C sensor/tolerance/soak plus final restore contract.

review_improvement: Prevents silent loss of width16 and converts a high-temperature loop into an attributable, stop-first-error transition ledger.
independent_technical_reasoning: The literal repeat boundary changes coverage: step19 ends after width8 readback, so width16 would occur only before or outside the loop depending interpretation. Criteria then mentions only generations, leaving all width results without an oracle. At 45C, repeated retraining can reveal temperature-dependent signal faults but also create persistent errors; preserving per-transition state and first failure is more informative and safer than a final clean grep.
